scope: Finish the existing standalone Go application: Preview -> Rename -> Move, with essential undo/recovery. No Walk migration, new UI, new PDF engine, printing pipeline or suite merger.
execution_rule: Code locally -> store in GitHub -> flowdev update dcm-quicksort -> flowdev test dcm-quicksort <selector> on Lenovo. One active native run. For defects: observed assertion RED -> smallest fix -> native GREEN -> full suite -> reviewed UI evidence.
tracking_rule: This supplements ../todo.json; original defect IDs and historical evidence remain authoritative. Completion of setup/diagnostic steps is not product acceptance or a percentage estimate. A RED baseline can close step 05 while product safety gates stay open. Revalidate affected evidence after source changes.
scope_control: New defects are recorded under the responsible step and must be resolved; do not expand the release with unrelated features merely to fill 50 steps.
evidence_policy: Each UI gate requires exact build identity, raw results and reviewed images; user_test is never inferred from automation. Code, UI and user-test statuses remain separate.

steps.feature: Pin the standalone source and scope
steps.acceptance: Identify app-src/ and installer-src/ at the exact candidate commit; retain the existing UI and Preview, Rename, Move scope.
Keep exactly 50 stable step IDs with acceptance, feature status, UI test, user test and evidence; preserve the original defect IDs.

steps.feature: Update Lenovo through the registered FlowDev profile
steps.acceptance: flowdev update dcm-quicksort succeeds and records the exact updated commit; no remote source editing.
Collect a bounded read-only host receipt; record disk and RAM, and allow only a serial targeted run when headroom permits. This is not a product PASS.

steps.feature: Recover the interrupted result and establish actual RED
steps.acceptance: Read the old timeout receipt, then obtain assertion failures for both remaining regressions; a timeout or zero tests does not count as RED.
After the observed RED, implement an atomic no-replace fast path in both the core and normal UI; the native regression preserves both original files.
After the observed RED, prevent duplicate-removal records from taking ordinary rename-chain reconciliation; restart requests attention instead of unsafe recovery.
Exact-path, hard-link and case-alias conflicts leave the source intact; retain all native assertions.

steps.feature: Qualify guarded copy and source retirement
steps.acceptance: Concurrent byte/identity changes, open writers and stale verification preserve data and require truthful recovery; all D2 regressions pass.
Changed or missing-fingerprint survivors cannot be restored as the original; empty-file and batch preflight cases pass.
Normal, replace and duplicate operations retain the correct batch identity across the journal/UI interruption boundary.
Non-default templates survive export/import and restore; tampered archives leave current configuration unchanged.
Backup/restore and upgrade retain default_source, pdf_default_view, vault_root and naming templates.

steps.acceptance: Navigation selects the correct adjacent visible file and handles the first, last and empty boundaries.
Ctrl/Shift selection matches the explicit operation set; native listbox automation and screenshots agree.
Refreshing or switching sources does not carry a stale selection, rename target or destination action onto another file.
Representative supported text files display actual contents; limits and unsupported encodings produce truthful states.
Representative advertised image types display actual content with existing sizing/navigation behavior.
A multipage PDF shows the correct visible page on next/previous and at page boundaries.
Manual zoom, 100 percent and fit modes retain visible page content; footer assertions alone cannot pass.
A representative document shows visible content using the installed handler or existing fallback; document layout limitations.
A representative workbook shows actual cell/sheet content; document limits rather than claiming Excel fidelity.
Representative slides contain visible text/images rather than a blank capture; document simplified fallback limits.
steps.qualification_note: DCM-14 baseline skipped TestRealGeneratedPPTXIntegration because DCM_REAL_PPTX was not supplied. This external-fixture parser check remains unverified alongside visible PPTX qualification; preserve original assertions and record the exact fixture identity.

steps.acceptance: DOC/XLS/PPT work when their required handlers exist and show an honest unavailable state otherwise; no new rendering engine is required.

steps.feature: Verify preview failure and interruption states
steps.acceptance: Unsupported, damaged or protected files do not masquerade as successful blank previews; navigation/cancellation follows the supported contract.

steps.feature: Verify preview cleanup and file release
steps.acceptance: After switching/closing previews, owned workers and file locks are released so rename/move can proceed.

steps.feature: Verify Rename through the normal UI
steps.acceptance: Rename an ordinary fixture and exercise spaces, Unicode, case-only names, invalid names and conflicts without data loss.
Undo the selected rename; original name and bytes return without overwriting an occupied old location.
The supported destination controls resolve the intended folder; invalid and unavailable paths are rejected before mutation.
Normal UI movement affects only the selected fixture; independent source/destination and hash checks match the displayed outcome.
Use an isolated second volume; verify copied bytes, guarded source removal and truthful failure/partial states.
Exercise the existing Skip, Keep Both, Replace and duplicate choices on disposable fixtures; each follows its documented data-preservation contract.
Only the confirmed selected files move; per-file results, failures and batch membership match independent checks.
Successful, refused and partial operations are represented honestly; merely viewing history performs no file mutation.
Restore original name/location/bytes for the intended operation; refuse changed or occupied destinations safely.
Restart the normal candidate and undo the intended batch; include interruption/recovery and unavailable-original cases with independent byte checks.

steps.feature: Run final normal-app workflow and image review
steps.acceptance: Complete Preview -> Rename -> Move -> restart -> Undo on the final candidate; review retained images for actual visible success/error/blank states.
steps.qualification_note: DCM-17 screenshot review found no-match wording and clipped/crowded labels at the tested scaling/geometry. Resolve or explicitly disposition before final release; functional DCM-17 acceptance is not global layout approval.

steps.feature: Build and verify the exact final package
steps.acceptance: Run package qualification; full suites and private-registry engine checks pass; app, setup and embedded payload identities are recorded.

steps.feature: Qualify setup UI and installer lifecycle
steps.acceptance: Test actual setup cancellation plus isolated clean install, upgrade, restore and uninstall; preserve user data and verify Explorer registrations in a disposable user/VM.

steps.feature: Record user acceptance and prepare the release draft
steps.acceptance: Record actual user feedback, reconcile all open gates and write truthful preview limitations; bind the draft assets to the exact successful package receipt.

steps.feature: Approve and publish the qualified release
steps.acceptance: Only after all required gates and explicit publication approval, publish the exact qualified artifacts and verify release metadata/assets; otherwise retain an unpublished draft.
